verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. LORD, I come to you for safety. Never let me be put to shame. Rescue me because you do what is right.
Turn your ear to me. Come quickly to rescue me. Be my strong rock, a fortress to save me.
You are my rock and my fortress. For the honour of your name, lead me and guide me.
Free me from the trap that is hidden for me, because you are my safe place.
I put my spirit into your hands. Rescue me, LORD, faithful God.
I hate those who worship worthless idols. But I trust in the LORD.
I will be glad and celebrate because of your faithful love. You saw my suffering. You cared about my deep troubles.
You have not handed me over to my enemy. You have set my feet in a wide-open place.
Be kind to me, LORD, because I am in trouble. My eyes, my soul, and my body are worn out with sorrow.
My life is used up by sadness and my years by groaning. My strength is failing because of my sin. My bones are wasting away.
Because of all my enemies, my neighbours look down on me completely. My friends are horrified by me. People who see me in the street run away from me.
People have forgotten me as if I were dead. I have become like a broken pot.
I hear many people whispering lies about me. There is terror all around me. They plot together against me and plan to take my life.
But I trust in you, LORD. I say, "You are my God."
My life is in your hands. Rescue me from my enemies and from those who chase me.
Let your face shine on me, your servant. Save me because of your faithful love.
LORD, do not let me be put to shame, because I have called to you. Let the wicked be put to shame. Let them lie silent in the grave.
Shut the lips of liars, who speak proudly and with hatred against good people.
How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who respect you! You give it to those who come to you for safety, in front of everyone.
You hide them in the safety of your presence from people who plot against them. You keep them safe in your shelter from accusing tongues.
Praise the LORD, because he showed me his amazing, faithful love when I was in a city under attack.
In my panic I said, "I have been cut off from your sight!" But you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.
Love the LORD, all you his faithful people! The LORD protects those who are faithful to him, but he pays back the proud in full.
Be strong and brave, all you who put your hope in the LORD.
